# WM Modular Scale

> Typographic scale calculator, fluid `clamp()` CSS token generator, and Gutenberg / GeneratePress / GenerateBlocks typography bridge for WordPress.

## Facts

- Version 1.4.1. Requires WordPress 6.4+ and PHP 8.1+.
- Computes nine fluid steps (`--wm-step-neg-2`..`--wm-step-6` and `--ms-neg-2`..`--ms-6`), `theme.json` `fontSizes` presets, GeneratePress dynamic typography hooks, GenerateBlocks 1.x/2.x styles and `{{wm_scale_token}}`, WP 6.5+ Block Bindings (`wm-modularscale/tokens`), and WP 6.9 Ability (`wm-modularscale/compute-scale`).
- Seven compiled Gutenberg blocks (`wm-scale/*` via `build/index.js`): Fluid Heading, Fluid Lead Text, Fluid Container, Typographic Grid, Ratio Visualizer, APCA Contrast Badge, and Theme.json Exporter.
- Checks fluid steps against WCAG 1.4.4 zoom bounds (`max <= 2.5 x min`) and computes APCA `Lc` per `apca-w3 0.1.9`; no legal conformity is claimed.
- Zero-CDN invariant (self-hosted assets in `/assets/`, Google Fonts dequeued by GeneratePress bridge), opt-in uninstall (`wmmsp_delete_data_on_uninstall`, default `0`), and 28 complete `.po`/`.mo`/JED `.json` translation catalogs.
